parts.style: warm, gentle, calm, settling into a slow bedtime tone
parts.text: Find a comfortable position... and let your body settle into the bed. <short pause> Close your eyes, if you have not already. <short pause> Take a slow breath in through your nose... and let it go. <short pause> Again, breathe in gently... <short pause> and release.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: Tonight, we rest in the truth that God keeps our minds in peace... when we trust in him.

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: You may notice thoughts moving through your awareness. <short pause> Plans for tomorrow. Something you forgot to do. A worry that keeps returning. <short pause> These thoughts are like clouds, drifting across the sky. <short pause> You do not have to chase them, or push them away. <short pause> Simply notice them... and let them pass. <short pause> Breathe in slowly. <short pause> Breathe out.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: Beneath the moving thoughts, is something steady. <short pause> Beneath the noise, is stillness. <short pause> Beneath the rush... is God. <short pause> He does not change with your circumstances. <short pause> He is the same when your mind is calm, and when it races. <short pause> You can turn your attention to him now... like turning your face toward light.

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: Another thought may come. <short pause> Let it drift by, like a cloud. <short pause> Breathe in. <short pause> And out.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: Your mind does not have to be empty to be at peace. <short pause> It only needs to be anchored.

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: When a ship is anchored, the water still moves around it. <short pause> Waves rise and fall... but the ship stays. <short pause> Let your thoughts be like those waves. <short pause> They come... they go. <short pause> But you remain anchored in the presence of God. <short pause> Breathe slowly.

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: There is an ancient promise that speaks to this. <short pause> Listen as it is read.
Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee. <short pause> Isaiah, chapter twenty-six, verse three. <long pause>

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: Perfect peace. <short pause> Not because your mind is perfectly still... but because your mind is stayed on him. <short pause> When you notice you have wandered into worry, or planning... you have not failed. <short pause> Simply return. <short pause> Turn your attention back to God... like turning your face back to the light.

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: Breathe in his peace. <short pause> Breathe out what you cannot carry.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: The clouds keep drifting. <short pause> That is their nature. <short pause> But the sky behind them does not move. <short pause> God is that steady sky. <short pause> Your trust in him is the anchor. <short pause> Let your breath be slow, and easy.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: Rest now in his keeping. <short pause> He holds you through the night. <short pause> Your racing thoughts do not trouble him. <short pause> He is not anxious. <short pause> He is not overwhelmed. <short pause> And he keeps you in perfect peace.

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: Let yourself sink deeper into rest. <short pause> Breathe.

parts.style: prayerful, hushed, very slow, a gentle blessing
parts.text: The Lord bless you, and keep you. <short pause> The Lord make his face to shine upon you, and be gracious to you. <short pause> The Lord lift up his countenance upon you... and give you peace.
